notes: Primary table row10 independently identifies threat-versus-control test. Original requested b is not printed for this contrast; extracted printed t without conversion. Paper also prints regression b=.39 (condition main effect) and b=.18 (interaction with affiliation), which are different tests. Replication table rounds t to -0.05 and calls 339 final analysis N; SI gives t=-0.049, p=.961 but df138 makes analytic n unresolved. Success quote explicitly addresses manipulation failure; primary contrast also described as showing no significant differences.
